name: Fast Food & Co
kurzbeschreibung: Fast Food & Co in Neustift im Stubaital: burgers and fresh snacks to eat in or take away, open all year round.
beschreibung: Fast Food & Co is located in the centre of Neustift im Stubaital, at Dorf 14, and is a restaurant and snack bar open all year round. The menu includes, among other things, juicy burgers as well as fresh, quickly prepared dishes for a small or large appetite – ideal for a bite in between. Guests can enjoy their food on site in a relaxed atmosphere or pick it up in the shop; there is no delivery service. Opening hours are Monday closed, Tuesday to Sunday from 11:00 to 00:00. The establishment is located in the main town of the Stubai Valley, a popular holiday area south of Innsbruck with the Stubai Glacier and Schlick 2000 nearby.
